Expertise

What I Take On

Specialized mobile engineering capabilities I bring to product teams.

📱

Cross-Platform Mobile Development

Production-ready Android and iOS mobile applications built from a single Flutter codebase. Clean MVVM and Riverpod architecture, strict state isolation, and pixel-perfect UI execution.

⚡

Clean Architecture & State Management

Enterprise-grade code separation with Riverpod, Bloc, and Provider. Decoupled presentation, domain, and data layers that make mobile codebases easy to scale, test, and maintain.

🎨

Figma to Pixel-Perfect Flutter UI

Direct translation of Figma design systems into responsive, fluid Flutter widgets. Smooth micro-interactions, custom animations, adaptive layouts, and native dark/light themes.

🔌

REST APIs & Realtime Firebase

Robust networking layers with Dio and Retrofit, automated JSON serialization, token refresh interceptors, Firebase Auth, Cloud Firestore, and real-time WebSockets.

💾

Offline-First Storage & Caching

High-speed local key-value persistence with Hive and SQLite. Background synchronization and optimistic UI updates so apps function flawlessly even in poor connectivity.

🌐

Localization & Multi-Language Support

Complete internationalization (i18n) frameworks for multi-language applications (English and Nepali), RTL support, and multi-tenant white-label build flavors.
